name: Kanem–Bornu Empire
summary: One of the longest-lived empires in African history, based around Lake Chad. It grew rich from trans-Saharan trade and converted to Islam in the 11th century.

location.value: Around Lake Chad: parts of Chad, Nigeria, Niger, Cameroon and Libya.

terrain.value: The Lake Chad basin, between the Sahara and the savannah.
terrain.source: Lange, Ancient Kingdoms of West Africa (2004)

climate.value: Semi-arid; Lake Chad’s size changed with the climate.
climate.source: Lange, Ancient Kingdoms of West Africa (2004)
